nodes.label: LCP & TBT Performance Optimization
nodes.rationale: Prevents injection of heavy libraries like GSAP on the main thread or Root Layout to avoid blocking cellular load times (Total Blocking Time). Forces dynamic loading or use-client wrappers for heavy components.

nodes.label: Hybrid Animation Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Optimizes First Contentful Paint (FCP) to near 0ms by using pure Tailwind CSS utility animations for initial mounting. Limits interactive GSAP animations to user actions like scroll, hover, or micro-nudges.

nodes.label: SSoT via transformEventForUI
nodes.rationale: Establishes a strict Single Source of Truth for event displays, ensuring humans, search engines (via JSON-LD), and AI agents (via llms.txt) always read identical data, preventing discrepancies in pricing, dates, and locations.

nodes.label: DRY and Domain-Driven Colocation
nodes.rationale: Eliminates clutter in the components/ folder by colocating domain components inside folders and reserving the root for page-level orchestrators. Promotes modular reuse and strictly segregated domain hooks.

nodes.label: SOLID React & Next.js Principles
nodes.rationale: Translates classic SOLID into React rules: single-responsibility components (<200 lines), open-closed extensions, minimal props to prevent drilling, and dependency inversion via helper actions.

nodes.label: Dual Identity and Authentication Strategy
nodes.rationale: Decouples public attendee identification (Clerk) from sensitive corporate admin tasks (Supabase Auth) to provide isolated security boundaries and protect master operations.

nodes.label: Server Actions Data Access Layer
nodes.rationale: Replaces REST endpoints with Next.js Server Actions, restricting raw database access, CRUD operations, and external API requests exclusively to secure server runtimes.

nodes.label: Keap CRM Real-Time Sync
nodes.rationale: Synchronizes contacts and tags automatically. Utilizes Supabase WebSockets to stream mass update progress to administrators in real time.

nodes.label: Upstash Redis Cache Layer
nodes.rationale: Slashes application latency and offloads database queries by caching database records and tags using high-performance Upstash Redis.

nodes.label: Tailwind v4 CSS Variable-Based Tokens
nodes.rationale: Utilizes Tailwind CSS v4's direct CSS variables and @theme inline declarations to support multi-theme adaptability natively, removing the need for a tailwind.config.js file.

nodes.label: DotScrollbar Elastic Scroll System
nodes.rationale: Acts as the single, reusable custom scroll indicator. It scales and stretches vertically via GSAP to reflect scroll speed and plays a loading wave upon initial load.

nodes.label: animateCardsTransition Filter Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Centralizes filter-based GSAP transition sequences, ensuring that changes to categories, subcategories, or months play identical animations without code replication.

nodes.label: Camaleonic Multi-Theme Engine
nodes.rationale: Enables the dashboard to switch dynamically between 5 distinct themes (Light, Dark, Synthwave, Hacker, Coffee) by strictly utilizing semantic variables and CSS class mapping rather than hardcoded tailwind colors.

nodes.label: Clerk Theme Propagation
nodes.rationale: Propagates the app theme variable mapping directly into Clerk authentication containers using the appearance prop to maintain a visually unified login experience.

nodes.label: Camaleonic SVG Styling Rule
nodes.rationale: Forbids the use of static colors or tailwind classes within inline SVGs, forcing CSS variables inside inline style tags to guarantee correct rendering of vector shapes when themes switch.

nodes.label: llms.txt AI Optimization (AIO)
nodes.rationale: Exposes all live, formatted event data dynamically in a standard markdown /llms.txt path, optimising search bot indexers and AI agents for factual consumption.
